No masterclass

Most of 247k can’t say yes yet

Someone who just found you through a reel or the podcast isn’t ready for 12 weeks of high-touch work. Today there’s nothing in between, so most people stay followers.

No first purchase

Book readers don’t reach your list

Someone who buys Deeper Than Money in a bookshop doesn’t land on your email list, so you can’t invite them further. There’s no product of your own between free and the Accelerator.

No ads

Applications rise and fall with your posting

Every new round depends on organic reach. There’s no way to turn ad spend into a predictable number of qualified applications.

The people who aren’t ready to apply today leave with nothing to buy, and you can’t see which of them will be ready next round.

A free Rich Life Money Masterclass between your content and your application

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Do I need to be good with money already?

No. This class is built for people who feel behind. Come as you are.

What if I can’t make it live?

Will you tell me what to invest in?

No. This is financial education, not personalised financial or investment advice. You’ll learn how things work so you can make informed decisions or ask a licensed professional better questions.

Why is it free?

Because the first step with money should feel easy, not expensive.

Script 1 · “Week two”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“If every budget you start dies in week two, this is for you.”

Body

“It’s not because you’re bad with money. Most budgets ignore the stuff underneath: the guilt, the stories, the shame. Fix the spreadsheet without fixing that, and you’re back where you started by the end of the month.”

CTA

“I’m teaching what to do instead in a free live masterclass. Replay included. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, casual setting, on-screen text “week two”.

Script 2 · “What comes first”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Pay off debt, save, or start investing? Here’s how to decide.”

Body

“Trying to do all three at once is why so many people feel stuck. There’s an order that makes it simpler, and once you see it, your next step gets obvious. This is education, not advice, and it works for any income.”

CTA

“I’ll walk through it in my free Rich Life Money Masterclass. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a simple 4-step graphic: debt, savings, investing, retirement.
